description: Smarter defaults for colors on the web.

latest_release.name: The Future is Here
latest_release.body:
![giphy-2](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/1748143/12006609/0710b0f0-ac18-11e5-924f-1573d354ef90.gif)

Postcss is the future. In the spirit of the year coming to a close, I'm updating this project to represent what is to come in the world of front-end development. 

The project is less monolithic now. Before - the main repo contained all of the pre-processor partials along with a complicated gulpfile. Now the main build system is just using posts and everything runs with a simple `npm start`. There are dedicated modules for [sass](https://github.com/mrmrs/colors-sass), [less](https://github.com/mrmrs/colors-less), and [stylus](https://github.com/mrmrs/colors-stylus). Myth has been deprecated.

The repo is a lot more simple now. Simple takes time and thought. But I think it's better.

Happy Holidays.
